Author: Michiru Tsukikage
Name: Tsukimichi
Description:
A quest catalog for every journal type, with completed and available filters and a per-requirement breakdown of what still blocks a quest.
Moonlit treasures collects quests with unique rewards, and per-character snapshots keep the whole account in view.
Local only: no network code.
Punchline: Walk the moon's path: every quest, every requirement, every unique reward.
Changelog:
Familiar faces

• Faces where they belong. Quest-giver portraits were re-cut by hand so faces sit in the middle, and each quest shows a character as they looked at that point in the story.
• Photos built in. Quest-giver photos now come with Tsukimichi, so there's nothing to download. Turn them off in Settings, under Look.
• Sort Moonlit. Click a column header in Moonlit to sort by it; click again to reverse.
• One click for Umbra. If you use Umbra, Tsukimichi can put its widget on your Umbra bar for you, and take it off again.
